verdict.rationale: Mollie's hosted checkout lets customers choose among multiple payment methods from one integration, and the Magento 2 docs describe an Apple Pay button on cart, checkout and product pages. The pack never shows Google Pay, bank redirect methods or BNPL. Apple Pay is only evidenced in the Magento plugin context, not the core API. missing for 10: Google Pay evidence, bank-redirect methods (e.g. iDEAL/Bancontact) evidence, BNPL evidence, a documented method list for the Payments API/hosted checkout, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: These hosted payment pages allow your customer to select their payment method of choice and to complete the payment.
Display the Apple Pay button on your cart, checkout, and product pages
